description: A powerful .NET CLI tool that converts Markdown documents (including Mermaid diagrams in both Dagre/ELK engines) into professional Word (.docx) documents with full formatting preservation.
releaseNotes: v1.1.1: Fixed critical browser crash during parallel Mermaid rendering - added automatic retry with browser recovery, graceful degradation, and comprehensive error handling.
title: Markdown To Word (md2word)
